description.value: Juniper Market is a neighbourhood specialty grocery and convenience store that has served the Juniper Ridge community in southeast Kamloops since 2009. It stocks fresh produce, bakery items from Craig's Bakery, and a deli with daily-made "Grab & Go" sandwiches and salads alongside hot items like samosas and butter chicken from local partner Mystikk Flavors. For touring cyclists resupplying in Kamloops, it offers a genuine one-stop shop without needing to descend into the city centre.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at junipermarket.ca is fully accessible and provides address (#301 - 2049 Highland Place, Kamloops, BC V2E 0A8), phone (778-471-5502), and detailed descriptions of products. The grocery and hot food amenities are confirmed by multiple subpages (grocery, deli, bakery). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website.
Website footer shows ©2018 copyright, suggesting the site may not be regularly updated, though the content appears current and operational.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-stocked neighbourhood grocery store with hot food in southeast Kamloops; a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists, though bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed.

Hot food.detail: Deli subpage describes hot case items including samosas, pakoras, butter chicken, and rice from in-store partner Mystikk Flavors

wow_evidence: deli with daily-made "Grab & Go" sandwiches and salads alongside hot items like samosas and butter chicken
